name: Tishana
description: Tishana is an elder of the River Heralds, a merfolk Shaper and illusionist who mentors Kopala and Kumena and works to keep Orazca hidden.

summary.text: Tishana is an elder of the River Heralds, a merfolk Shaper and illusionist who mentors Kopala and Kumena and works to keep Orazca hidden.

bio.text: Tishana insisted the Immortal Sun must be kept unused, while her former student Kumena argued the River Heralds must wield it, and Kopala sided with her.

citations.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.
"The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.
"The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

bio.text: She pursued Kumena to the coast, overpowered his spell, and was knocked out by his punch.

citations.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.
"The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

bio.text: Huatli woke her, and Tishana agreed to guide Huatli to Orazca, warning she would kill her if she tried to claim it.

citations.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.
"The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.
"The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

bio.text: She later demanded the compass from Jace and then abandoned Huatli to stop Kumena alone, breaking their bond.

citations.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.
"The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

bio.text: She arrived at Orazca with her clan, confirmed her agreement with Huatli, and with her fought Vona for the Immortal Sun.

citations.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citations.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citations.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citations.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

bio.text: After the Immortal Sun vanished, she declared Orazca found and Ixalan at peace and agreed the River Heralds are open to negotiation.

citations.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.
"Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

status.text: As of the canonical story, Tishana and Huatli part as friends with an agreement to negotiate.

citations.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Kopala meditates in the Primal Wellspring with Tishana and feels the pulse of Orazca skip a beat.
timeline.quote: The pulse skips a beat.

citation.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana tells Kopala the disturbance involves Orazca.
timeline.quote: And what involves Orazca involves the whole world,

citation.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Kumena arrives at the Wellspring with twenty River Heralds and a captured Sun Empire soldier.
timeline.quote: A soldier of the Sun Empire, bedraggled but whole, bound with a tangle of vines.

citation.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Kumena argues that the River Heralds must wield the Immortal Sun themselves, while Tishana insists it must be kept unused.
timeline.quote: We must wield the power of the Immortal Sun ourselves

citation.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana says the Last Guardian entrusted them to keep it hidden and unused, and Kumena appeals to Kopala to break the tie.
timeline.quote: He entrusted us to keep it hidden,

citation.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Kopala sides with Tishana, saying no one should claim the Golden City, including the Heralds.
timeline.quote: We must do everything in our power to prevent anyone from claiming the Golden City.

citation.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Kumena drowns the captive soldier, warns that Tishana's strategy will fail, and rushes off in a wave of water and roots as vessels approach the coast.
timeline.quote: and then he is gone from the glade

citation.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana departs to pursue Kumena and tells Kopala to rally the people, admitting the city may not stay hidden.
timeline.quote: I do not think we can keep the Golden City hidden any longer.

citation.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana catches up with Kumena on the coast, where he conjures storms against approaching ships, and she overpowers his spell.
timeline.quote: I subsume his spell with magic of mine own.

citation.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana rams a ship into a sea stack and exchanges barbs with Kumena before he punches her and knocks her out.
timeline.quote: I look over my shoulder just in time to see Kumena's fist hit my face.

citation.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli teams with Tishana to keep Kumena from the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: Huatli temporarily joined up with the merfolk Tishana

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Search for the Immortal Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Everyone scrambles to touch the Immortal Sun and a current of energy rushes through them.
timeline.quote: everyone scrambled to touch the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Search for the Immortal Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk, Brazen Coalition, Kumena, Huatli, Angrath and Vraska race to Orazca for the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: In the race for Orazca, the planeswalker Angrath joined the fray, as well.

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "The Race". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vona steals the Thaumatic Compass from Vraska; Huatli and Tishana retrieve it.
timeline.quote: she managed to steal the Thaumatic Compass from Vraska

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A conjured storm tosses Vona's ship, which rams into a sea stack and wrecks on the shore.
timeline.quote: just as her ship rammed into the side of the sea stack

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli finds the unconscious Tishana on a rock and wakes her.
timeline.quote: There, lying on the rock overlooking the vast, unending ocean, was an unconscious female merfolk.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana tells Huatli that a River Herald, Kumena, has betrayed her cause and is heading to Orazca.
timeline.quote: A River Herald has betrayed my cause and is traveling there now.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli kneels and swears she means no claim on Orazca, and Tishana agrees to guide her, warning she will kill her if she tries to claim it.
timeline.quote: We are not each other's enemy.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana senses that Huatli really did see the city and gives her the terms of the alliance.
timeline.quote: If you say you saw a city when you skimmed the edges of our world, then I believe you.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana animates a jade totem into an elemental mount.
timeline.quote: began to form the shape of an elemental

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana spots an illusion on the river water, which she judges beyond the vampires' mastery.
timeline.quote: Someone is casting an illusion there, on the water.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana and Huatli resolve to take the compass from the illusionist's boat, and Tishana admits even the River Heralds do not know where Orazca is.
timeline.quote: We need their compass more than we need them dead

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace goes to track the vampire but hears the minds of Tishana and Huatli pursuing it.
timeline.quote: What he heard instead was a pair of furious internal monologues.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana's illusory flying snake crashes into Jace's psychic defense.
timeline.quote: An immense, illusory, flying snake crashed into his arms and split on either side of Jace's psychic defense.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana snares Jace with vines, breaking his illusion.
timeline.quote: vines whipped up from the forest floor to wrap themselves around Jace's legs.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana and Huatli introduce themselves and Tishana demands the compass or their deaths.
timeline.quote: Hand over the compass or die where you stand.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace tells them the vampire took the compass, and Tishana and Huatli leave to hunt it.
timeline.quote: The vampire took the compass from us.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli and her dinosaur hunt the vampire for nine hours.
timeline.quote: It took nine hours.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana examines the compass, which lights and shows Orazca is half a day away.
timeline.quote: The end of our peregrination is near.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana betrays Huatli as the Belligerent crew ambushes them and Amelia binds Huatli in canvas.
timeline.quote: the slap of a large flap of canvas covering her face and knocking her off her mount

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli summons clawfoots that scatter the pirates, and Tishana conjures a flood against the fleeing crew.
timeline.quote: she summoned a flood to careen through the jungle

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana abandons Huatli to stop Kumena alone, breaking their bond.
timeline.quote: I must stop Kumena on my own.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Kumena nears Orazca using little magic to avoid Tishana.
timeline.quote: He was nearing the golden city of Orazca, the resting place of the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Kumena reaches the Sanctum of the Sun but is bested by Vona and Mavren Fein and thrown out of the tower, then saved by Tishana.
timeline.quote: he was saved in time by his former teacher, Tishana

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "The Fight for Control". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A brawl erupts in the chamber and everyone scrambles to touch the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: everyone scrambled to touch the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "The Fight for Control". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tishana arrives with her clan and confirms her agreement with Huatli stands.
timeline.quote: I assembled my clan. Our agreement stands.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli leaves Angrath under the dinosaur and goes with Tishana.
timeline.quote: Angrath, I'm sorry, but I need to go with Tishana. We had a deal first.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli and Tishana enter Orazca and see a dark storm rising from its tower.
timeline.quote: after some time, Huatli blinked sweat from her eyes as she passed through the gate of the golden city.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Kumena falls from the tower and Tishana's wind breaks his fall.
timeline.quote: The body's descent slowed and then stopped altogether as a massive gust of wind rose up to break the fall

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Tishana proposes they take the vampires together and resolve ownership afterward.
timeline.quote: We can take them together,

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli and Tishana burst into the Sun chamber and Vona claims the Immortal Sun for the Legion of Dusk.
timeline.quote: I am Vona, Butcher of Magan, and the Immortal Sun belongs to the Legion of Dusk!

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Tishana's elemental slams into Vona while Huatli takes on the hierophant.
timeline.quote: Her elemental had grown large once more and barreled into Vona's side as she stood on the Immortal Sun.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli, Tishana, Angrath and Vona all touch the Immortal Sun and a surge of energy passes through them.
timeline.quote: The four of them gasped as an immense current of energy passed through them.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: The Immortal Sun vanishes and Huatli, Tishana, Vona and Angrath fall into the room below.
timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun vanished beneath their feet

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda arrives and asks whether the Immortal Sun is gone.
timeline.quote: Is it gone, children of night?

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Tishana declares Orazca found and Ixalan at peace.
timeline.quote: Orazca is found

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli says Orazca belongs to no one and should be shared.
timeline.quote: Orazca belongs to no one,

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Tishana agrees the River Heralds are open to negotiation.
timeline.quote: Yes. The River Heralds are.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Tishana is left alone in Orazca after Huatli departs (non-canon River Heralds ending).
timeline.quote: Tishana watched as Huatli departed on the back of the elder dinosaur.

citation.work: Rivals of Ixalan Magic Story Alternate Endings
authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Rivals of Ixalan Magic Story Alternate Endings" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Tishana distrusts the Sun Empire under Emperor Apatzec III.
timeline.quote: The Sun Empire was still ruled by Emperor Apatzec III, after all.

citation.work: Rivals of Ixalan Magic Story Alternate Endings
authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Rivals of Ixalan Magic Story Alternate Endings" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Tishana commands the elementals to guard every entrance against non-merfolk forces.
timeline.quote: Tishana willed them to stand guard, to be ready for any non-merfolk force that may try to enter Orazca.

citation.work: Rivals of Ixalan Magic Story Alternate Endings
authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Rivals of Ixalan Magic Story Alternate Endings" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Tishana resolves to settle the River Heralds permanently and rename the city the City of Golden Water.
timeline.quote: The River Heralds would settle here permanently

citation.work: Rivals of Ixalan Magic Story Alternate Endings
authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Rivals of Ixalan Magic Story Alternate Endings" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Tishana summons all merfolk to a tribal congress, the largest assembly of merfolk bands in Ixalan's history.
timeline.quote: summoned all merfolk who could hear her to the tribal congress so that they could decide together the fate of the plane

citation.text: "River Heralds", section "Matzalantli". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: breaks from her over wielding the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.
"The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

relations.note: Huatli regards Tishana as a traitor after being abandoned.
relations.quote: Damn merfolk! Where did that traitor go?!

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

relations.note: He avoids magic so Tishana cannot find him.
relations.quote: Any greater act of spellcraft would have led Tishana straight to him.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

relations.note: They part as friends with an agreement to negotiate.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.
